title: Certifying Reward Alignment in Portfolio Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34153v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial reinforcement learning often translates an investment objective into an additive risk-adjusted reward. An agent can optimise that reward accurately yet implement a different financial preference. We develop a decision audit for terminal mean-variance equilibrium that separates reward misspecification from learning error. In a finite exogenous-state market, we bound the gain from changing one action using actor, reward and continuation-critic residuals. The certificate ignores state-constant critic offsets, accommodates convex action constraints, and has an independent-sample extension that does not require the equilibrium policy. A continuation-aware actor-critic method estimates the future-policy correction from samples. Across nine controlled markets and twenty seeds, it reduces policy distance by and one-step deviation gain by relative to a matched myopic-reward network. translated_title: 投资组合强化学习中的奖励一致性认证
translated_abstract: 金融强化学习通常将投资目标转化为可加的风险调整奖励。智能体可以精确地优化该奖励，却可能实现与预期不同的金融偏好。我们开发了一种针对终端均值-方差均衡的决策审计方法，将奖励误设定与学习误差区分开来。在有限外生状态的市场中，我们利用行动者残差、奖励残差和延续评论家残差来界定改变单个动作所获得的收益。该认证忽略了状态恒定的评论家偏移量，可容纳凸动作约束，并具有无需均衡策略的独立样本扩展形式。一种感知延续的行动者-评论家方法从样本中估计未来策略修正。在九个受控市场和二十个随机种子的实验中，相对于匹配的短视奖励网络，该方法降低了策略距离和单步偏差增益。一项单独的PPO比较测试了相同的奖励区间……
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向投资组合强化学习的奖励一致性认证方法，通过基于行动者、奖励和延续评论家残差的决策审计，将奖励误设定与学习误差区分开来，从而验证智能体是否真正实现了投资者的均值-方差金融偏好。
